motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: 按钮和表格行的状态反馈。

motion.name: loading-pulse
motion.purpose: 加载骨架 opacity 从 1 变到 0.48；reduced motion 时关闭。

components.name: 主按钮
components.description: 错误状态下重新加载列表。
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; padding:9px 15px; color:#fff; background:var(--accent, #17634c); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; font-family:Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#104b39; } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background:#dcebe2; color:#174e3c; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #459a7c; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

components.name: 次要按钮
components.description: 刷新列表或清除当前页筛选。
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; padding:9px 15px; color:#304c40; background:#fff; border:1px solid #bdcec5; border-radius:6px; font-family:Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#edf3ef; } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background:#dcebe2; color:#174e3c; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #459a7c; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

components.name: 商品搜索框
components.description: 带可见标签的当前页筛选。
components.css: .ds-search { width:238px; max-width:100%; font-family:Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-search label { display:block; font-size:12px; color:#52665c; margin-bottom:6px; } .ds-search-wrap { position:relative; } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; left:11px; top:10px; width:20px; height:20px; color:#728179; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; pointer-events:none; } .ds-search input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:40px; padding:8px 10px 8px 38px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #b8c8c0; color:#253d35; border-radius:6px; font:13px Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; caret-color:var(--accent, #17634c); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:#6b7b73; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #459a7c; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-search input:disabled { background:#f4f6f5; }

components.name: 详情操作
components.description: 表格中的查看详情操作，选择后同时显示文字与底色。
components.css: .ds-detail-action { color:var(--accent, #17634c); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; padding:10px 4px; font:600 12px Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; text-underline-offset:3px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-detail-action:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-detail-action:active { background:#dcece2; } .ds-detail-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #459a7c; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-detail-action[aria-pressed=true] { color:#376e56; }

components.name: 选择标签
components.description: 在详情面板标题旁说明已有商品被选择；不是可点击筛选器。
components.css: .ds-selected-label { display:inline-block; background:#e9f2eb; color:#306447; font:11px Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; border-radius:4px; padding:4px 7px; }

components.name: 内容面板
components.description: 商品列表或详情的白色内容面板，以细边界划分，不使用阴影。
components.html:
商品详情

选择一件商品，查看价格与可用库存。
components.css: .ds-panel { color:#253d35; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line, #dce4df); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; font-family:Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0; padding:24px 22px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #dce4df); font-size:17px; line-height:1.5; font-weight:650; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; padding:25px 22px 30px; color:var(--muted, #60716b); font-size:13px; line-height:1.9; }

narrative.overview: 第二步商品查询使用 Operate 模式。页面让使用者快速扫描商品、价格和库存，再打开详情；不增加与当前业务无关的数据图、指标或装饰。此处记录已实施的界面，未声称全项目设计系统已经完成。
